First release of Eclipse: Moonlight and Sunshine for SteamOS Gaming Mode, controller only.

**Install:** Decky settings → Developer → *Install plugin from URL*, with the link of `Eclipse-0.1.0.zip` below.

### Play: stream games from a PC (Moonlight)
- Paired hosts with live status, resume the last game in two presses, Wake-on-LAN (automatic before a stream).
- Add host finds PCs running Sunshine on your network; pairing from Gaming Mode, with the PIN entered on the host automatically when its Sunshine login is saved.
- Quality presets, including *Auto: match display*, per-host presets, host monitor selection.
- Steam library shortcuts per host and app.
- Connection checks per host in *Troubleshooting*.

### Share: let other devices stream from this one (Sunshine)
- **Sunshine for Gaming Mode**: Sunshine's official build set up to stream Gaming Mode without a black picture and without forcing gamescope composition (no extra battery use).
- Off unless you turn it on; *Start automatically* and *Turn off automatically* are options, both off by default.
- See who is streaming from the device and end it from the Quick Access menu; optional notifications.
- Pairing requests show up in the Quick Access menu; Sunshine login can be created automatically.
- Sets a first SteamOS password from Gaming Mode when the device has none.

### Quick Access menu
- Play and Share tabs, pinned, switched with LB/RB; whatever is happening right now (playing, sharing, pairing requests) sits on top.

Known limitation: Sunshine does not report which device is streaming, only how many.
